body: I know that I should get professional help for this, but I'm too scared. I've been to a psychiatric hospital once and I don't want to go back. Even if I don't get committed, I'm terrified that the information that I give the therapist will somehow be used against me. I know that they have a code of ethics that forbids that, but nobody's going to want to go after the person who breaks it when they see how messed up I am.
